import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
d2i=G['Demo pair 2 input']; d2o=G['Demo pair 2 output']
# rule: cell between two markers in same row/col -> 2, else keep
def f(g,bg):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]!=bg]
    out=[[bg]*W for _ in g]
    for i,r_ in enumerate(g):
        mk=[j for j,x in enumerate(r_) if x!=bg]
        for a,b in zip(mk,mk[1:]):
            for j in range(a+1,b): out[i][j]=2
    for j in range(len(g[0])):
        mk=[i for i,r_ in enumerate(g) if r_[j]!=bg]
        for a,b in zip(mk,mk[1:]):
            for i in range(a+1,b): out[i][j]=2
    for p in pts: out[p[0]][p[1]]=g[p[0]][p[1]]
    return out
print('demo2:',f(d2i,6)==d2o)
# demo1
d1i=G['Demo pair 1 input']; d1o=G['Demo pair 1 output']
print('demo1:',f(d1i,5)==d1o)
out=f(G['Test input'],0)
for r_ in out: print(' '.join(map(str,r_)))
print(json.dumps(out))

    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); ti=G['Test input']
def f(g,mk,bg):
    pts={(i,j) for i,r_ in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r_) if x==mk}
    rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
    r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs); c0,c1=min(cs),max(cs)
    # ensure all four corners are markers; else use extreme-corner markers instead
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    corners=(r0,c0),(r0,c1),(r1,c0),(r1,c1)
    ok=all(p in pts for p in corners)
    rr_,cc_=None,None
    if ok: rr_,cc_=r0,r1,c0,c1
    else:
        # find four marker cells closest to extremes: topmost row markers with min/max col among them
        rows_with=topmost=min((r,p) for r,p in pts)[1]  # placeholder
        cand_rows=sorted({p[0] for p in pts})
        top_row=min(cand_rows)
        bot_row=max(cand_rows)
        tl=[p for p in pts if p[0]==top_row and p[1]==min(p[1] for q in pts if q[0]==top_row)]
        tr=[p for p in pts if p[0]==top_row and p[1]==max(p[1] for q in pts if q[0]==top_row)]
        bl=[p for p in pts if p[0]==bot_row and p[1]==min(p[1] for q in pts if q[0]==bot_row)]
        br=[p for p in pts if p[0]==bot_row and p[1]==max(p[1] for q in pts if q[0]==bot_row)]
        (r0,c0),(r0,c1),(r1,c0),(r1,c1)=tl[0],tr[0],bl[0],br[0]
    for i in range(r0,r1+1):
        for j in range(c0,c1+1):
            if i in (r0,r1) or j in (c0,c1):
                if out[i][j]==bg: out[i][j]=2
    return out
for n,mk,bg in [('Demo pair %d'%(i),list(Counter(x for r_ in G[f'Demo pair {i} input'].values())).index(min(Counter(x for r_ in G[f'Demo pair {i} input'].values()))),None) for i in range(1,7)]:
    pass
# redo cleanly: per-demo mk = least common color, bg = most common

    print(i, f(gi,mk,bg)==go)

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); ti=G['Test input']
def f(g,mk,bg):
    pts={(i,j) for i,r_ in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r_) if x==mk}
    rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
    r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs); c0,c1=min(cs),max(cs)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    corners={(r0,c0),(r0,c1),(r1,c0),(r1,c1)}

    print(i, f(gi,mk,bg)==go)

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); ti=G['Test input']
for i in range(1,8):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {i} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    cnt=Counter(x for r_ in gi for x in r_)
    mk=min(cnt,key=lambda c:cnt[c]); bg=max(cnt,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    pts={(a_,b_) for a_ in range(H) for b_ in range(W) if gi[a_][b_]==mk}
    # find painted cells that are NOT on bbox perimeter; characterize them
    pb=set((a_,b_) for a_ in range(H) for b_ in range(W) if go[a_][b_]==2 and gi[a_][b_]==bg)
    rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    inter=[p for p in pb if not(p[0] in(r0,r1) or p[1] in(c0,c1))]
    print(f'd{i}: perim-only-painted={len(pb)-len(inter)}, interior-painted:',inter)

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); ti=G['Test input']
for i,mk,bg in [(7,6,8),(4,7,4),(6,9,5),(3,3,8),(5,6,8),(2,2,8),(1,3,8)]:
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {i} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    cnt=Counter(x for r_ in gi for x in r_)
    mk=min(cnt,key=lambda c:cnt[c]); bg=max(cnt,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    print('=== d',i)
    for a_ in range(H):
        row=''
        for b_ in range(W):
            ch = 'M' if gi[a_][b_]==mk else ('P' if go[a_][b_]==2 else '.')
            row+=ch
        print(row)
